# Cognito identity pools

Link supported logins to identities and exchange them for local STS role credentials.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `cognitoidentity` |
| Signing name | `cognito-identity` |
| Wire protocol | AWS JSON 1.1 |
| API version | `2014-06-30` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Local behavior |
| Selected operations | 19 of 23 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#cognito-identity-pools) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- Social login providers are rejected.
- STS and IAM limitations apply to issued credentials.
- Only selected pool and mapping members are implemented.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
